capabilities.description: Move the observable arm tool to a bounded world position.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: tasks/catalog.json mw_reach_target/terminal_endpoint supplies the exact public criterion <= 0.05 m. Real instance piper-mw_reach_target in assets/reach_scene.xml supplies target [0.55, 0.1, 0.43] and its declared reset places site ee_site at [0.00181149139694, -0.498948667057, 0.365250452141] m. Request bounds are the exact coordinate-wise reset/target envelope; nominal is the deterministic midpoint and calibrated-boundary is the package target. Duration bounds are timestep 0.002 s through instance timeout 20 s; both cases receive that same timeout so difficulty differs only by target. The midpoint is a fixed protocol formula, not empirical calibration.

capabilities.description: Move arm tool a requested distance along a world direction.
capabilities.effect: Requested displacement of body link6 within the public reach tolerance.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: The same public mw_reach_target/terminal_endpoint tolerance is <= 0.05 m. Real reset-to-target vector [0.548188508603, 0.598948667057, 0.064749547859] has length 0.814519889678 m and normalized world direction [0.673020408157, 0.735339522886, 0.0794941273743]. Cases request exactly 50% and 100% of that measured vector length; the trusted operator measures requested displacement error, not mere positive progress. The 50% point is a declared protocol choice, not empirical calibration.

capabilities.description: Set the observable gripper slide joint position.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: Real scene assets/reach_scene.xml declares joint joint7 with exact m range [0, 0.035], and the declared reset resolves to 0.035. Request bounds are narrowed to the measured nominal/boundary envelope [0, 0.0175]. Real trusted actuator gripper was evaluated from declared reset 0.035 toward both exact MJCF limits: target 0: terminal 5.44030212348e-21, error 5.44030212348e-21, actual displacement 0.035, executable=True; target 0.035: terminal 0.035, error 0, actual displacement 0, executable=False. The farther executable limit 0 is boundary; nominal is its reset midpoint 0.0175. Three real reset/controller/physics repeats per case produced errors [6.245004513516506e-17, 6.245004513516506e-17, 6.245004513516506e-17] and [5.440302123479827e-21, 5.440302123479827e-21, 5.440302123479827e-21]. experiment/experiment3/fixed_inputs/calibration_report.json#robots/piper/capabilities/C3 seals max error plus 64 * IEEE-754 binary64 epsilon * max(1, abs(lower), abs(upper), span) = 1.42733047603e-14 m; this remains below nominal reset displacement 0.0175. Selected constant controls were nominal 0.0175 and boundary 0.
